intent: Edit a small collection of topic labels directly, with an explicit count and visible removal controls.

layout.direction: A roomy wrap-first topic well with fitted tags, 44px remove controls and a lightweight count. Return focus to the text entry after adding or removing a topic.
layout.container: Use a full-width container capped at 32rem with 24px padding. Keep long topic labels wrapping inside the well at 320px.

motion.entrance: A single opacity and 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: 150ms button press response and 200ms tag layout transitions. No ambient loops.
motion.reduced: Settle the entrance and tag layout without transforms when reduced motion is active or changes while mounted. Preserve entry focus and content.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled tags. Without onChange, editing is read-only.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Maximum additions; existing host tags are never silently removed.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Synchronous proposal with an independent tag array; controlled tags wait for host acknowledgement.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Parse Enter, comma and pasted comma/newline lists; trim pieces, deduplicate case-insensitively and retain accepted order.
Respect IME composition. Remove the last tag with Backspace only when the entry is empty; return focus to the entry after addition or removal.
Keep independent copies of incoming defaults, local tags and emitted arrays so host mutation cannot alter the field.
Apply a finite nonnegative addition limit without silently deleting existing host tags. At the limit, retain removal and block further entry.
Controlled values wait for the host; proposals report a requested change. Controlled values without a writer and disabled instances cannot edit.
